latestVersion.changelog:
Maker Free Hindi 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create Hindi-captioned videos for free using cloud rendering, with quick setup and 1080p MP4 downloads.
- Upload videos or images (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 500MB) and generate videos with Hindi text or subtitles by simple instructions.
- Seamless session management: Automatic token generation and session setup; users get 100 free credits for 7 days.
- Covers workflows for editing, credits checking, export, and upload, with clear error handling and status updates.
- Supports a variety of file types for input, including video, audio, and images, with real-time feedback during processing.
- Best suited for Hindi content creators needing fast, no-cost video production.
